items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: good Reed men like Handley. I mean, I used to listen to him a lot.

ctx.x: Now, who else would you say was outstanding, either on record or here in person?

You mean back in the old, the jazz days? Back in those days. Yeah. Well, we had guys like, good Reed men like Handley. I mean, I used to listen to him a lot. I liked his, he was a real good, hard, steady rolling Reed man. And Henry Harden, he had quite an outfit one time. And now the day, you know, some of the folks who came along with me who still here around in the city, like the Knott brothers, the twins, they're Reed men. They're pretty nice musicians too. Back in place. I can't play, Sam.
